title: Contracting for Information: Heterogeneous Costs and Investment Opportunities
abstract: arXiv:2609.15019v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A principal faces a decision problem under uncertainty and can contract with a researcher to provide relevant information. The cost of acquiring information is only known to the researcher, and, moreover, by privately making an investment the researcher can reduce their expected cost. We show that this contracting problem can be viewed as an information design problem with cost constraints and use techniques from that literature to solve for the optimal contract. The principal never overinvests but may underprovide investment even when it is efficient. We establish a cutoff in the cost of investment below which the principal induces investment and show that this cutoff is higher for a better investment opportunity, in the sense that the post-investment distribution of costs improves in the monotone-likelihood-ratio order.

translated_title: 信息合约：异质性成本与投资机会
translated_abstract: 一个委托人在不确定性下面临决策问题，可以与研究者签订合约以获取相关信息。获取信息的成本只有研究者自己知晓，此外，通过私下进行投资，研究者可以降低其预期成本。我们证明这一合约问题可以被视为一个带有成本约束的信息设计问题，并运用该领域的相关技术求解最优合约。委托人从不过度投资，但即使投资是有效率的，也可能出现投资不足。我们确立了投资成本的一个临界值：当投资成本低于该临界值时，委托人会诱发投资，并且我们证明，对于更好的投资机会——即投资后成本分布在单调似然比序意义上有所改进——这一临界值更高。
tldr: 该论文将委托人与研究者之间的信息获取合约问题重构为带成本约束的信息设计问题，证明委托人从不过度投资但可能放弃有效率的投资，并给出诱发投资的成本临界值——投资机会越好，该临界值越高。
en_tdlr: This paper recasts contracting for information as an information design problem with cost constraints, showing the principal never overinvests but may underprovide efficient investment, and identifies a cost cutoff for inducing investment that rises with the quality of the investment opportunity.
